items.title: GAP-14 successor: LIVE phase-gate validation via env_kwargs() (crossing-count vs legacy spike), with a raw-trajectory-divergence precondition -- 591h vacuity fix
items.note:
REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-591h (NEW EXQ number, not a 591 letter, per infant_gap14_redesign_staged_20260827.md and the autopsy's own instruction (c)). Routed by the user-adjudicated failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-591h_2026-09-03 (ratified REE_assembly d51fc6aaa5, recorded on infant_substrate:GAP-14 governance_2026_09_03): 591h PASSED 5/5 seeds but was VACUOUS -- per_episode_h_pos was BIT-IDENTICAL between ARM_SPIKE and ARM_CROSSING on 5/5 seeds because the only phase->agent channel the 591b-591h lineage wired was config.e3.novelty_bonus_weight, whose consuming branch was DELETED 2026-05-25 (dead-by-construction).

ORIGINAL GOVERNANCE INSTRUCTION named TWO required live channels: env_kwargs() and config_overrides()['offline_integration_frequency']. THIS DESIGN SHIPS ONLY ONE (env_kwargs()) -- the second was investigated, wired in a first draft, then DROPPED after the mandatory Step 4.5 adversarial red-team (run on a different model, fable) found the workaround for it was itself a dead channel. Full disposition below.

(a) env_kwargs() -- LIVE, SHIPPED. InfantCurriculumScheduler.env_kwargs() is spread in full into the CausalGridWorldV2 constructor every episode (harm_gradient_enabled -> causal_grid_world.py:2617 harm-gradient reward term consumed by update_residue() -> ResidueField.accumulate() -> ARC-046 hazard-avoidance term in E3 trajectory scoring; transient_benefit_enabled -> :3077 stochastic benefit-patch spawn). Genuine closed loop, verified reachable by direct construction probe (Step 2.5a) before any script code was written, AND verified firing live in the final script via a diagnostic tick counter (info['transition_type']=='harm_gradient'; see n_harm_gradient_ticks / n_harm_gradient_ticks_by_cell in the manifest) -- added specifically per red-team finding F3 to directly confirm the channel engages, not merely that it is wired.

(b) offline_integration_frequency -- INVESTIGATED, NOT SHIPPED (RED-TEAM F1). config_overrides()['offline_integration_frequency'] (10->20 on Phase0->1) matches agent.py:12070's should_integrate() cadence field, but REEAgent.offline_integration() itself is confirmed-broken (a bare torch.cat([s,w]) at default dim=0 instead of dim=-1, agent.py ~12053-12058, crashing once the E1 experience buffer exceeds 10 entries -- confirmed via a direct 15-step probe and by comparison to the correct sibling usage at agent.py:5775-5777; this is why grep confirms zero scripts in the whole ree-v3/experiments/ corpus have ever called agent.offline_integration() or agent.should_integrate()). A FIRST DRAFT worked around this by calling should_integrate() at the correct cadence and, on a True tick, invoking only the confirmed-safe residue-only half, agent.residue_field.integrate(). Step 4.5 red-team (fable) found THIS HALF IS ITSELF DEAD: ResidueField.integrate() (ree_core/residue/field.py:1120-1141) computes F.mse_loss(neural_field(...), rbf_field(...)).item() with NO .backward(), NO optimizer, NO .step(), and NO in-place write anywhere -- neural_field's parameters are referenced nowhere else in the whole ree_core/ tree, so nothing anywhere trains them. Its only real effect is that torch.randn_like(...) (10 draws/call) advances the GLOBAL torch RNG stream, which every downstream stochastic draw (CEM noise, E3 multinomial, replay) then consumes differently on a schedule correlated with curriculum phase -- a genuine but SPURIOUS source of per_episode_h_pos divergence between arms that the new P6 precondition (below) CANNOT distinguish from a real one. Wiring it as originally drafted would have manufactured a subtler repeat of the exact 591h vacuity failure rather than fixing it. DECISION: this channel is not wired at all in the shipped script; agent.config.offline_integration_frequency is never set; should_integrate()/residue_field.integrate() are never called. Recorded as TWO entries in the manifest's substrate_defect_found (one per confirmed-dead half) and folded into scope_limitation. config.e3.novelty_bonus_weight remains deliberately unwritten too (dead since 2026-05-25, per the original instruction).

NEW LOAD-BEARING PRECONDITION (governance requirement (b), independent of the channel-count question above): raw_trajectory_divergence_present, evaluated FIRST (before gate_green/dropout_bypassed/c_discriminates) -- counts episodes across ALL seeds where ARM_SPIKE and ARM_CROSSING's RAW per_episode_h_pos sequences differ by more than float noise (|diff|>1e-9). This is the exact guard 591h lacked: its own C_arms_differ compared the gate's DECISION output (reached_phase1, phase_01_at), which can (and did) report True even while behaviour was bit-identical, because a different threshold applied to an IDENTICAL underlying signal still fires at a different episode. Below floor -> label=substrate_not_ready_requeue / vacuous, never a substrate-verdict label. C_arms_differ_decision_level is retained as a diagnostic-only (non-load-bearing) criterion, explicitly named in the script docstring as 'the 591h-insufficient statistic'. New EXQ number, claim-free (CLAIM_IDS=[]; 591h's ARC-019 tag is not carried forward, per the autopsy's tag-removal instruction).

RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, fable, independent model from the author) -- SECOND FINDING (F2), ALSO FIXED: once env_kwargs() is genuinely live, ARM_SPIKE's own post-advance episodes run under different (Phase-1) dynamics that depend on ARM_SPIKE's own gate decision -- so the ORACLE (h_pos_mean_full_run on ARM_SPIKE, used as ground truth for 'is this seed a genuine explorer') and P2 (a post-hoc recount of ARM_SPIKE's post-advance h_pos values against the spike threshold) both became contaminated by the manipulation under test, unlike in 591h where env_kwargs was informational-only. FIXED: (i) oracle switched to h_pos_mean_pre_ep_min -- the mean over episodes [0, PHASE_EP_MIN[1]=100), provably Phase-0-only and bit-identical-in-composition across arms since InfantCurriculumScheduler._try_phase_0_to_1 refuses to advance before episode 100 under either gate rule; the ORACLE_H_POS_MEAN_FLOOR=0.20 numeral was originally calibrated against 591d/591f's full-run means, so applying it to the pre-ep_min statistic is an approximation -- readiness preconditions P3/P4 self-route to substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than silently passing through a poorly-calibrated floor. (ii) P2 (crossing_counts_reach_gate_minimum) switched to read ARM_CROSSING's own live scheduler_crossing_count directly (the exact statistic the gate itself computes and routes on) instead of a post-hoc recount off a different arm's trajectory.

RED-TEAM MINOR/NOTE FINDINGS (no further script change beyond F3's cheap sharpening, described under channel (a) above): F4 confirmed the torch.cat bug claim is real (independently traced); F5 verified no other vacuity risk (arm_cell resets all RNG per seed so Phase-0 trajectories are cross-arm bit-identical by construction; replay_diversity_enabled defaults False so hippocampal stdlib-random sites are unreachable; residue_scale_factor scope note accurate; env-kwarg spread, should_integrate() arithmetic, scheduler wiring, and phase-timing bounds all check out); F6 (cosmetic) corrected a pre-filled 'red-team: CLEAR' docstring line that predated the actual review.

SCOPE LIMITATIONS (deliberate, documented in the script docstring and manifest): config.e3.novelty_bonus_weight NOT written (dead channel). residue_scale_factor NOT applied (governance named only env_kwargs()+offline_integration_frequency as required channels; out of scope to add a third). offline_integration_frequency NOT applied at all (see RED-TEAM F1 above -- both its E1-replay half and its residue-only half are confirmed dead). No torch.multinomial-dependent assertions on committed/sampled actions -- all thresholds are on upstream continuous quantities (h_pos, crossing counts), for cross-machine-class safety.

GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): decisive readout n_diverging_episodes_total / C_live_gate_discriminates. Checked evidence/experiments/ and the queue/experiments tree for any existing run wiring env_kwargs() live on this curriculum -- none found (only the 591 lineage exists, all confirmed wiring only novelty_bonus_weight). Not recoverable from existing data -> run.

STEP 2.5c (substrate-path overlap gate): queried evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json for open 'corrupting' entries touching causal_grid_world.py/agent.py/infant_curriculum.py. Two found (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) -- both gated behind flags (use_salience_coordinator/use_external_task_drive, use_lateral_pfc_analog) this script's diversity-armed build does not enable (verified against _agent_config_kwargs()). Ruled non-blocking.

COUPLED CONTRACT PIN CHECKED (ree-v3/tests/contracts/test_infant_curriculum_gap9.py:262-264, test_c7_config_overrides): read in full -- it asserts only properties of InfantCurriculumScheduler.config_overrides()'s own return value (residue_scale_factor increasing, offline_integration_frequency increasing 10->20, novelty_bonus_weight>0 in every phase), never references any 591-family driver. This script does not modify config_overrides()'s shape, only which fields (if any) the driver consumes. NO CHANGE NEEDED; no working-tree changes were made to this file or any other tracked file (the new driver script is the only untracked addition).

DESIGN (unchanged from 591f/591h): discriminative pair, ARM_SPIKE (legacy single-episode spike gate) vs ARM_CROSSING (phase_0to1_use_crossing_count=True, min 3 crossings per 591f). Seeds 42-46, 160 episodes, 200 steps/episode, diversity-armed agent (MECH-313 noise floor + MECH-314 structured curiosity, SP-CEM main-path default). REFERENCE_591F frozen positive-control cells (verified byte-identical to 591h's own values) used via assert_anchor_reachable at setup to structurally prove every readiness predicate can clear its own gate -- unaffected by the pre-ep_min oracle switch since it is a structural check on the predicate machinery only, not a live-run comparison. Readiness preconditions P1/P3/P4/P5 carried over unchanged (spike-arm-reproduces-advance>=2, oracle-genuine-explorers-present>=1, oracle-non-explorers-present>=1, live-false-advancer-present>=1); P2 redefined per red-team F2 above. LOAD-BEARING C_live_gate_discriminates: in ARM_CROSSING, for every seed, the live phase-advance decision agrees with the ORACLE label -- gated behind the new P6 divergence precondition.

validate_experiments.py --strict: clean pass, 0 warnings across all 30 checks, no exemptions (re-verified after the F1/F2 fixes). --dry-run smoke (2 seeds x 2 arms, 3 episodes x 25 steps): exit 0 both before and after the F1/F2 fixes, all 4 cells ran to completion with real env_kwargs applied per phase (confirmed via [train] log lines printing the live env_kwargs dict each episode), z_goal_stream smoke 'no writer defect', correctly self-routed label=substrate_not_ready_requeue (expected at toy scale -- no seed reaches the spike gate in 3 episodes, so precondition P1 correctly fails closed rather than asserting a false substrate verdict).

COST: estimated_minutes set to 360, matching 591h's OWN measured wall-clock (5h46m for the same 2-arm x 5-seed x 160-episode x 200-step design on ree-cloud-2, per that queue entry's own COST note) -- this script's overhead beyond 591h's (env_kwargs() spread, one diagnostic tick counter) is negligible relative to per-step CEM planning cost, and it does LESS work than a first-draft two-channel version would have (no should_integrate()/residue_field.integrate() calls at all), so the per-step cost profile is at or below 591h's.

QUEUE-APPEND SERIALIZATION: this entry is prepared by a queue-experiment subagent operating under a centrally-serialized fan-out (a /failure-autopsy pause lock currently covers ree-v3/experiment_queue.json, REE_assembly/evidence/, claims.yaml, WORKSPACE_STATE.md). Per the delegating orchestrator's explicit instruction, this session does NOT edit experiment_queue.json, does NOT commit, does NOT push, and does NOT run /session-land -- the orchestrator lands this entry (and the coupled-set: this entry alone, since the contract-pin check above concluded no contract change is needed).

items.title: MECH-161 vigilance inverted-U vs monotone (MECH-093 heartbeat-rate sweep, hazard-detection SDT)
items.note:
MECH-161 (backlog EVB-1446): tests whether hazard-detection sensitivity (hit_rate-false_alarm_rate on a signal-detection readout, reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-981's calibrated _hazard_cells/_avoidant_action/_hazard_bin apparatus) is an INTERIOR-OPTIMUM (inverted-U) function of the MECH-093 E3-heartbeat rate P in [5,8,10,15,20], vs a MONOTONE 'faster is better' function (MECH-026's alternative). 3 seeds x 5 heartbeat levels; agent trained once per seed at P=TRAIN_HEARTBEAT_STEPS=10 (frozen thereafter), then evaluated (eval-only, no retraining) at all 5 levels -- an operating-point sweep isolating the heartbeat manipulation from training-quality confounds (precedent: WORKSPACE_STATE 2026-08-22 'operating-point sweep' entries). Non-monotonicity test (pre-registered): the level with the highest cross-seed-mean sensitivity must be INTERIOR (not P=5 or P=20) and must beat both extremes by margin >= max(MARGIN_ABS_FLOOR, MARGIN_SD_MULT * pooled_cross_seed_SD, ddof=1). Positive control: sensitivity range across levels must clear DV_MOVEMENT_FLOOR, else non_degenerate=False (flat-curve self-report, not a false null). Per-(seed,level) hazard-bin coverage (SAFE/AMBIGUOUS/HIGH) must each clear MIN_BIN_COVERAGE_STEPS=5, else non_degenerate=False (an under-sampled bin voids the run rather than reporting a noisy rate). P0 readiness gate: baseline (P=10) sensitivity must exceed POSITIVE_CONTROL_MARGIN, else the run self-routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue (evidence_direction=non_contributory) rather than a false verdict.

STEP 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = 'interior-vs-extreme heartbeat-level detection sensitivity margin'. claims.yaml MECH-161 carries evidence:[] (zero prior runs). reanalysis_query.py-equivalent search found no manifest sweeping e3_steps_per_tick against a signal-detection DV on a compatible substrate_hash (V3-EXQ-097/097b/116/505 probe MECH-093 mechanics directly, not detection performance; V3-EXQ-981 probes MECH-027 hypervigilance via precision/horizon/replay forcing, never heartbeat rate). Not recoverable -> run.

STEP 2.5/2.5a substrate readiness: MECH-093 (ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py MultiRateClock.update_e3_rate_from_beta / _current_e3_steps) confirmed IMPLEMENTED and genuinely continuous by direct source read (2026-09-03): e3_steps_per_tick interpolates linearly between beta_rate_min_steps=5 and beta_rate_max_steps=20 as a function of ||z_beta||, not a binary switch. MECH-026/ARC-016/ARC-044 (MECH-161's other depends_on) are conceptual/architectural with no separate substrate gate; already exercised by V3-EXQ-981's identical harness pattern.

STEP 2.5b re-derive brake: zero prior autopsies for MECH-161 (0 total runs) -- below the >=2 threshold. Not braked.

STEP 2.5c substrate-path overlap: no open corrupting-severity substrate_queue.json entry touches ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py, agent.py's clock-tick path, or hippocampal/module.py's propose_trajectories (checked 2026-09-03).

STEP 4.5 RED-TEAM (model 'fable', adversarial causal-chain review withholding my own Step-3.5 conclusions per skill instructions): returned BLOCKING on the first pass. FAMILY 1 finding (manipulation-cannot-reach-DV, CONFIRMED by my own independent source trace, not merely trusted): the custom _agent_tick harness's own docstring claimed it 'keeps update_e3_rate_from_beta from ever running' -- this was FALSE. _agent_tick calls agent._e1_tick(latent) on virtually every step (e1_steps_per_tick=1), and _e1_tick unconditionally calls self.clock.update_e3_rate_from_beta(z_beta) at agent.py:5866 with NO gating flag, overwriting agent.clock._current_e3_steps (clock.py:221) from live z_beta magnitude. Traced through clock.advance()'s actual read order (clock.py:127-160): the eval harness forced _current_e3_steps=P only once at level/episode ENTRY, so only the FIRST step of each episode read the forced P correctly -- every step thereafter read whatever MECH-093's live dynamics computed, not P. Verified empirically via a standalone probe (agent.clock._current_e3_steps read at every step of a 15-step rollout, seed 42, P=5 vs P=20): pre-fix, both P traces collapsed onto the SAME z_beta-governed trajectory by step 2 ([5,16,14,13,...] vs [20,16,14,12,...] -- identical at step 2). This would have made every downstream hit_rate/false_alarm_rate/sensitivity(P) reading a measurement of MECH-093's own arousal dynamics, not of the swept P -- a genuine BLOCKING defect that changes the causal chain itself.

FIX APPLIED (one iteration, per skill instructions): _agent_tick gained an optional force_heartbeat parameter that re-asserts agent.clock._current_e3_steps=int(force_heartbeat) immediately AFTER the _e1_tick() call (i.e. after MECH-093 has run and overwritten it, but before the next step's advance() call reads it), so the forced period survives from one advance() call to the next. _run_eval_level now passes force_heartbeat=heartbeat_steps; _train_warmup passes force_heartbeat=None (training deliberately runs under MECH-093's live, uncontrolled dynamics -- the fixed rate is only the eval-time manipulation). MECH-093 still runs every eval tick under this fix -- nothing is bypassed or disabled -- only its output is prevented from persisting past that tick. Re-verified by the same standalone probe post-fix: agent.clock._current_e3_steps stays pinned at the forced P on every one of 15 steps for both P=5 and P=20 ([5,5,5,...] and [20,20,20,...]). validate_experiments.py --strict re-run clean after the fix (0 warnings across all categories, identical to the pre-fix run). A fresh --dry-run smoke test after the fix ran end-to-end without error, reproducing the expected substrate_not_ready_requeue outcome at dry-run scale (identical failure signature to the pre-fix smoke run -- the P0 gate correctly still fires at 5-episode warmup scale). Per skill instructions ('iterate at most once ... only if a BLOCKING finding changes the causal chain itself'), I treated the direct source-level trace plus the two before/after empirical probes as sufficient re-verification and did not spawn a second red-team pass.

OTHER RED-TEAM FAMILIES (verified, NOT code-blocking, handled by existing mechanisms rather than further code changes): FAMILY 2 (SAFE hazard-bin geometry near-empty on a 10x10 grid under the global-max-normalised hazard field -- confirmed by the red-team's own geometric argument, ~8.4% of cell pairs fall in the SAFE band) is mitigated by the pre-existing MIN_BIN_COVERAGE_STEPS=5 per-(seed,level) coverage gate already folded into non_degenerate (added during Step 3.5 self-review, prior to the red-team pass) -- an under-sampled bin voids the run rather than reporting a noisy false_alarm_rate. FAMILY 3 (routing a noisy null as 'weakens' rather than inconclusive; np.std population-vs-sample-SD understatement) -- fixed the ddof=0->ddof=1 (Bessel-corrected sample SD) understatement in per_level_sd, since population SD with only 3 seeds understated required_margin by ~1.22x, making the pre-registered test slightly too easy to pass; the broader 'flat-curve-as-null-routed-to-weakens' risk is bounded by the existing DV_MOVEMENT_FLOOR positive-control gate (a truly flat/noisy curve reports non_degenerate=False rather than a directional verdict). FAMILY 4 (torch.multinomial machine-class non-determinism on E3's uncommitted-selection path) is not code-fixable within this experiment (it is a cross-machine-class property of the substrate per the umbrella CLAUDE.md 'Running the test suite' note) -- instead the script now RECORDS committed_fraction (n_committed_ticks/n_e3_ticks) per level, per seed, in both level_results and the stamped arm row (level_committed_fraction), so a cross-machine-class replication can check whether a result depends on the non-reproducible multinomial-sampling stream.

STEP 3 non-tautology / DV-symmetry-invariance declaration: the manipulated variable P=agent.clock._current_e3_steps changes WHEN a fresh E3 score vector is computed (not a uniform additive score-bias constant that argmax would cancel), and sensitivity(P) is a behavioural EVENT RATE over realised trajectories under a frozen policy (not a re-ranking of a fixed candidate set, and not a permutation of interchangeable units) -- ruled out broadcast-constant, monotone-rescaling, and permutation-symmetric degeneracies per the script's own module-docstring declaration.

DEVIATIONS FROM THE STANDARD SKILL PATH (orchestrator-directed, /metaworker-orchestrate daily-science fan-out, session daily-20260903-exq999-mech161): did NOT edit ree-v3/experiment_queue.json (a /failure-autopsy pause lock covers it; queue appends are serialized centrally by the orchestrator); did NOT run Step 8 (no commit, no push, no coordinator POST); did NOT edit REE_assembly/evidence/ (incl. experiment_proposals.v1.json -- EXP-0869/LIT-0870 proposal-status update deferred to the centralized queue-append step); did NOT edit WORKSPACE_STATE.md or claims.yaml; did NOT run /session-land; did not spawn chips. The experiment script itself (untracked in ree-v3, not git-added/committed) and this queue-entry JSON are the deliverables; the orchestrator (or its designated queue-append step) is responsible for landing both.

FLAGS ENABLED: none beyond the script's own hardcoded config (no default-off REEConfig flags flipped for this design -- the harness reads/writes agent.clock._current_e3_steps directly rather than through a REEConfig knob, matching V3-EXQ-981's precedent for this class of clock-forcing harness).

items.title: SD-e1 ITEM 3 validation: rollout-endpoint contrastive vs three incumbents (h=1 divergence)
items.note:
SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 3 validation (rollout_sequence_divergence_loss, e1_deep.py, landed ree-v3 df551f38fe 2026-09-03). 4 arms x 6 seeds (42,123,7,2024,17,31): ARM_OFF (depth-0 single-step, 965/968/976 baseline), ARM_ANCHOR (V3-EXQ-968 stateful output_proj_residual, strongest prior incumbent), ARM_RC_DECAY (ITEM 2 rollout_consistency_loss, horizon=5 decay=0.5, the stronger 976 arm), ARM_RSD (ITEM 3 rollout-endpoint InfoNCE contrastive, defaults). All arms action_conditioned_transition=True (ITEM 1) + action_cond_unzero_self_slot=True (unchanged, per 976's own null on it). Primary DV: cr_ratio(h=1) = CR_rollout/CR_real; relative-lift verdict vs ARM_OFF at fixed pre-registered LIFT_BAR=3.0 (976's convention, majority-of-6-seeds rule) PLUS absolute evaluator bars (cr_ratio(h=1)>=0.1 AND e1coe_score_var>=0.002, the SD entry's own text) which route the label independently of the relative-lift verdict. Trained-horizon (h=5) override applied per 976's convention. V3-EXQ-980's E1-alone readout carried at every checkpoint incl h=30, explicitly non-gating (user_decision_2026_09_02 Q2). RSD arm trains via a REAL-window replay buffer (H=5 windows from the online random-policy trajectory; K=8 sampled without replacement per uniform trailing-window trigger tick) and calls agent.e1.rollout_sequence_divergence_loss -- see module docstring 'RSD TRAINING IS BUFFER-BASED' for why this is licensed by the existing SD-056/V3-EXQ-701c precedent rather than requiring literal copy.deepcopy(env) branching.

Step 2.4 (GOV-REUSE-1): decisive readout = cr_ratio(h=1) under an E1 trained with rollout_sequence_divergence_loss. Searched evidence/experiments/ for any manifest carrying e1_rollout_sequence_divergence_enabled or any v3_exq_1000* prior run: none exists (ITEM 3 landed same day). Not recoverable -> run.

Step 2.5/2.5a: ITEM 3 confirmed IMPLEMENTED in ree-v3/CLAUDE.md ('SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 3' entry, 2026-09-03); empirically probed against origin/main df551f38fe -- rollout_sequence_divergence_loss signature, all 5 e1_rollout_sequence_divergence_* E1Config fields, and full 3-site REEConfig.from_dims() wiring (dataclass field + signature + assignment) confirmed present, closing the reference-reeconfig-from-dims-silent-kwargs hazard for this build.

Step 2.5b (re-derive brake): grepped REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_*.json for claim_ids containing MECH-135 or INV-088 with category substrate_ceiling: 0 hits for either. Brake not triggered. (Also N/A on its own terms: this is a new EXQ number targeting newly-landed substrate, not a lettered iteration of a prior autopsied run.)

Step 2.5c (substrate-path overlap gate): two open severity=corrupting substrate_queue.json entries touch e1_deep.py -- (1) SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training itself (paths ::forward, ::predict_long_horizon) -- the SANCTIONED exception; this run directly targets that entry per its own implementation_log item-3 validation-owed note. (2) contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (path ::ContextMemory.write) -- DISJOINT code locus; this script never constructs or calls ContextMemory (no cue-indexed retrieval anywhere in the driver), so no overlap in exercised paths. Documented pass-through, not a stop.

Cross-machine-class safe: no torch.multinomial-dependent assertions anywhere in the driver; every DV is a continuous rollout statistic (cr_ratio, e1coe_score_var, spread/centroid_norm ratios).

Step 3.5 code review: ASCII-only output verified (0 non-ASCII chars in file); validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings after adding ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT for the two anchor-kind preconditions, both of which ARE the degeneracy definition by construction -- see module ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT constant); one unused-import cleanup (P0NotReady/p0_readiness_gate, never called in this script -- removed). One real bug caught by the --dry-run smoke test and fixed: the RSD arm's random.sample() buffer-sampling call was drawing from the SAME shared `random` module stream that also drives random.randint() action selection, perturbing ARM_RSD's env trajectory relative to the other three arms and producing a non-zero e1_grad_step_gap_per_seed (measured 27/8 at smoke scale before the fix) -- this both broke the 'identical random policy, env, seeds' cross-arm control and threatened the e1_grad_steps_matched readiness precondition on a real run. Fixed by giving RSD's buffer sampling its own dedicated random.Random(seed+9000) instance, isolated from the shared action-selection stream. Re-verified: e1_grad_step_gap_per_seed = {0, 0} post-fix.

Step 4 (--dry-run smoke): ran to completion at reduced scale (2 seeds x 4 arms x 2 episodes x 50 steps) at every stage of development, with all 8 cells running the full Phase 0a/0b/1/2/3/4/4b/4c/e1-alone pipeline to completion and real (non-vacuous) numeric readouts at every horizon checkpoint on every pass -- no crash, no short-circuit, at any point. The FINAL post-red-team-fix smoke run self-routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue (status=FAIL, degeneracy_reason='P0 readiness unmet: rsd_action_sensitive') because the NEW rsd_action_sensitive gate (added in response to red-team findings #1/#2, see below) correctly detects that 2-episode/50-step training is nowhere near enough for E1 to learn genuine action-dependence: measured rsd_sensitivity_ratio_per_seed = {seed42: 1.0052, seed123: 1.0090}, both essentially at the exact null value of 1.0 (shuffling the action assignment made ~no difference to the loss) and correctly below the 1.05 floor. This is the INTENDED behavior of the new gate, not a bug -- it demonstrates the gate is reachable/non-vacuous (it can and does fire) rather than trivially satisfied, and correctly withholds a verdict on an undertrained regime rather than reporting a spurious PASS. e1_grad_step_gap_per_seed = {0, 0} (the earlier RNG-isolation fix, still holding); rsd_engaged_frac_per_seed = {1.0, 1.0} (the batch-diversity gate, still holding). Whether the full 100-episode/200-step run clears the sensitivity floor is exactly the open empirical question the full run answers -- see report for full disposition.

Step 4.5 red-team (model: fable): BLOCKING on first pass. Two blocking findings (#1 manipulation-cannot-reach-DV, #2 gate-certifies-own-subject): the replay-buffer substitution (K windows sampled from different times along ONE continuous trajectory, not literal siblings of one shared state) opens an 'identity shortcut' in a slow-drift env -- E1 could minimise the InfoNCE loss by predicting endpoint~=init without ever using the action sequence, and the existing rsd_objective_engaged gate (which only checks the SAMPLED BATCH's action-class diversity) cannot detect this, since it is silent about what the MODEL does with that diversity. FIXED: added a new rsd_action_sensitive readiness precondition + an action-sensitivity control (every RSD training tick, recompute the identical loss with the K action sequences row-permuted across samples under no_grad via an isolated RNG stream; ratio of shuffled-loss/real-loss must clear 1.05 on every seed, else self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue). Also fixed finding #4a (verdict-grid-maps-wrongly, medium): the trained-horizon override could relabel a genuine ARM_RSD DEGRADATION at h=1 as partial support ('lift_at_trained_horizon_only') merely because RSD also lifted at its own trained horizon h=5 -- excluded 'degrades' from the override-eligible label set, so a confirmed h=1 degradation is always reported as degrades regardless of the h=5 reading (which remains visible in arm_verdicts_trained_horizon). Remaining lower-severity/contested findings (h=5-loss-vs-h=1-DV mismatch; n=6/majority-4 statistical power; near-duplicate replay-buffer windows; ARM_ANCHOR train/eval hidden-state mismatch) recorded as known limitations, not fixed -- see report.

Design spec (binding, from Q1 2026-09-02 user-sanctioned decision + the ITEM 3 build report): 4 arms, n>=6 seeds, same h=1 evaluator bars as ITEM 1/2, LIFT_BAR=3.0 fixed pre-registered, trained-horizon override at h=5, 980's E1-alone readout carried non-gating, readiness preconditions = 976's 8-item list minus the bespoke grad-cosine non-vacuity apparatus (deliberately descoped -- ARM_ANCHOR/ARM_RC_DECAY reuse already-autopsy-confirmed code paths from 968/976) plus rsd_objective_engaged (the ITEM-3-specific non-degeneracy gate that self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a claim verdict, if the RSD loss never engages non-degenerately -- per the SD entry's explicit instruction).
